title: Top 10 Claude Code skills aur stars
content:
1 crore 80 lakh GitHub stars.
Yeh hain top 10 Claude Code skills.
Number 1 pe akele 30 lakh stars.

10. Claude Mem.
Claude purani baatein nahi bhoolta.

9. Addy Osmani ke Agent Skills.
Specs se ship tak.

8. Caveman.
Kam bolo, kam tokens.

7. G-Stack.
YC ke Gary Tan ka.
Akela Claude, poori team.

6. UI UX Pro Max.
AI wala generic design khatam.

5. Ponytail.
Utna hi code, jitna chahiye.

4. Anthropic ke official skills.
PDF, docs, slides.

3. ECC.
Planning, testing, review.
Sab ek pack mein.

2. Matt Pocock ke skills.
Chhote, roz kaam aane wale.

Aur number 1, Superpowers.
Pehle plan, phir test, phir code.

Poori list, install commands ke saath, chahiye.
Comment karo, skills.
Aur us dost ko bhejo.
